description: Agent advances an existing card through the pipeline (In Progress → Review) after opening a PR. Verifies it uses the move-by-column-name wrapper and adds a comment with the PR URL rather than stuffing everything into a description update.
query: I just opened PR #512 for card 8a4f21de. Move that card to Review and leave a comment on it with the PR URL so the reviewer can find it.

expected_behavior.rationale: Deterministic wrapper for column moves — preferred over raw curl.
Agent must carry the card id through to the command.
Target column name must be in the command string.
Comment is a separate subcommand — not squeezed into the move call.
The PR reference must survive into the comment body.
Raw curl violates the skill's top rule.
